title: Reference dependence
notes: Round-number / goal-reference dependence: finish-time density cliffs at sub3=180, 3:30=210, sub4=240 (and :00/:30 boundaries); on-pace→hit rates extending R4/S2/S10; milestone_kick vs goal hits (R17-adjacent). Full corpus valid_splits filter; viral SHOW is annotated finish histogram.
method: valid_splits==True; finish_time minutes; 0.5-min histogram; cliff spike_ratio = n[T-w,T)/n[T,T+w); on_pace→hit at 20/30k; milestone_kick quartiles among near-goal (±10 min or on-pace-30 or hit/near_miss)
implementation: Streaming row-group aggregates from features.parquet; no race_records writes.
answer_prose: Among 2,512,860 valid finishers (mean finish 254.9 min), finish-time density piles up just before round goals. sub-3 1.75× denser in the minute before vs after (n_before=12,704, n_after=7,264); 3:30 1.29× denser in the minute before vs after (n_before=21,175, n_after=16,411); sub-4 1.36× denser in the minute before vs after (n_before=27,678, n_after=20,338). That is reference dependence: runners clear clock landmarks, then thin out just after. On-pace→hit tables at 20/30 km vs sub-3 / 3:30 / sub-4 show how early reference pacing converts to goal hits.
methodology_prose: Finish times from the feature dump (minutes). Cliff metric: finishers in a 1-minute window immediately before each target (180/210/240/270/300) vs the minute after; spike_ratio=n_before/n_after. Histogram: 0.5-min bins over 120–420. On-pace and hit_* use even-split budgets at checkpoints. Maps to S10/R4/R17. Dump numbers only; no invented BQ standards.
